title: Jieqi, nearby: the dealt start and the evidence it was dealt, across a relaunch
why: The one game with no frozen start, so its configuration always names one — and the position it names is a deal rather than anything a person composed. The round trip proves the two things a dealt game adds. Its start survives a close and a reopen spelled out, because there is no constant for it to fold into; and the four values its handshake left behind survive it too, three of them through the document and all four through the wire session's own row, which the resume re-verifies against before the session exists: the seed hashes to the commitment, the deal it derives carries the digest, and that deal is the one the start spells. Its bytes are the archive corpus's jieqi-nearby-active golden. Undo is refused as in every nearby game.
